error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
name: Name
page_subtitle: Newsletters, offers, webinars, banners, social networks and subscribers.
no_campaigns: No campaigns yet. Create one from a template.
meta_today_hint: Daily limit to protect your SMTP quota
tpl_free_course: Give a course away for a limited time. The price goes back to normal automatically.
tpl_half_price: Cut a course's price in half for a few days.
tpl_flash_sale: A short (24 h) discount with a strong sense of urgency.
tpl_webinar: Invite your subscribers to a webinar or live session.
tpl_new_course: Announce the release of a new course.
tpl_newsletter: Newsletter with a featured course and a tip of the month.
tpl_reengage: Win back subscribers who haven't logged in for 30 days.
opens_note: Opens are estimates (some mail apps block images): clicks are the most reliable indicator.
cancel_confirm: Cancel this campaign? Emails not yet sent will not go out.
locked: This campaign has been launched: it can no longer be edited.
subject: Subject
placeholder_hint: Tip: write {{first_name}} to insert the recipient's first name.
lang_fallback: If a language is left empty, the other language's version is used. Each recipient gets the language of their account.
ph_text: Your text (a blank line starts a new paragraph)
divider_hint: A separator line between two sections.
offer_hint: The course price is changed automatically for the chosen duration, then restored on its own. Instructor commissions are calculated on the price paid.
promo_cancel_confirm: Stop this promotion? The regular price is restored immediately.
promo_commission_warning: During the offer, sales are recorded at the promotional price: instructor commissions are calculated on it.
include_contacts: Include newsletter visitors without an account
aud_never_enrolled: Have not taken any course yet
aud_breakdown: {{fr}} in French · {{en}} in English · {{contacts}} visitor(s) without an account
aud_prefs_hint: People who unsubscribed, or declined this type of message, are automatically excluded.
telegram_hint: The post goes out when the campaign launches, if Telegram is configured.
schedule_future: Pick a future date (at least 1 minute ahead).
confirm_send_now: Send this campaign now to {{count}} recipient(s)?
send_limit_hint: Sending happens in small batches to respect the daily limit. A large campaign may take several days.
banners_hint: Shown on the public site and the student area (not in administration). Visitors can close them.
telegram_setup: Telegram is not configured. Add TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID to the API's .env (create a bot with @BotFather and add it to your channel as an administrator).
linkedin_hint: LinkedIn does not allow pre-filling the text: copy it, then paste it in the window that opens.
manual_channel_hint: For this network, posting is manual: copy the text and open the share link. Automatic posting requires a developer account approved by the network.
contact_consent_hint: Only add people who agreed to receive your emails.
nl_pending: Thanks! Confirm your subscription with the link we emailed you.
nl_error: Could not subscribe. Please try again.
nl_consent: News, offers and webinars. Unsubscribe at any time.
prefs_invalid: This link is not valid or has expired.
pref_newsletter_hint: News and updates from the platform
prefs_unsubscribed: You are unsubscribed from all our promotional emails.
prefs_transactional: Emails related to your account (payments, security, certificates) are still sent.
save_first: Save first to use this feature.
pick_template_hint: Pick a ready-to-publish template: you then adjust it (course, dates, text) before sending. You can also create your own templates.
template_restore_confirm: Restore this template's original content? Your changes will be replaced.
template_hint: The template keeps the FR/EN content, the target audience and the settings. You'll find it under “New campaign”.
banner_presets_hint: Click a template to pre-fill the banner, then adjust it.
offer_mode_coupon: Promo code (only for those who have it)
coupon_mode_hint: The code is valid at checkout. It will be added to the email automatically as a “Promo code” block.
coupon_added_block: Code {{code}} created and added to the email.
ab_hint: Two subjects are tested on a small sample; the best one is automatically sent to the rest of the audience.
ab_min_audience: The test only runs from 20 recipients; below that, subject A is used for everyone.
ab_held: {{count}} recipient(s) are waiting for the test result.
automations_hint: Emails sent automatically based on subscribers' behaviour. Each person receives each automation only once. They are disabled by default: review the text, test, then enable.
auto_enable_confirm: Enable “{{name}}”? Emails will go out automatically.
auto_eligible_warn: {{count}} people are already concerned and will receive the email gradually (within the daily limit).
auto_vars_hint: Variables: {{first_name}} (first name) and {{course_title}} (course title, depending on the trigger).
trig_signup_hint: Applies to people who sign up after activation (existing accounts are not concerned).
trig_no_enrollment_hint: Applies to new sign-ups (after activation) who still haven't taken any course after the delay.
trig_inactive_hint: Also applies to accounts already inactive at activation time: sending is spread over the daily limit.
trig_course_stalled_hint: Course between 1% and 99% progress, with no activity for the delay (60 days maximum).
trig_course_completed_hint: After a course completed since the automation was enabled.
coupons_hint: A code gives a discount at checkout. It is checked server-side (dates, cap, per-person limit, eligible courses).
coupon_no_stack: A code cannot be combined with a running price promotion on the same course. If a payment is rejected or an enrolment deleted, the code is given back.
nl_section_subtitle: Free courses, discounts, webinars and DevOps tips, straight to your inbox.
nl_perk_offers_text: Free courses and discounts reserved for subscribers.
nl_perk_webinars_text: Invitations to live sessions with our experts.
offer_box_text: Pay {{price}} instead of {{old}} by entering this code at enrolment.
coupon_public_hint: The percentage and code appear on the matching courses.
share_hint: The link applies the code automatically at checkout: the easiest to share (WhatsApp, email, social).
